name: json-value-highlighter
description: Automatically mark the ref palette variable in jimu-theme. You can customize the json value to be marked by modifying jsonHighlighter.pattern.

jsonHighlighter.pattern.description: Regular expression used to match specific string values in JSON files. Must include one capture group.

jsonHighlighter.message.default: Theme `--ref-palette` css vars should not be used, please use the `--sys-color` css vars instead.
jsonHighlighter.message.description: Message shown when a matching value is found.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
